text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having run through the race while still 
riding the high, Eishin Flash could now 
see things that had eluded her until now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It is every single girl's obsession with 
victory— She resolves to surpass those 
driven to take that very last step and 
become number one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A special feature article was set to be 
written about her. Facing the working 
title "Flash," Eishin Flash gave a 
fearless smile, declaring she would shine 
until the very end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"The End"――Foreseeing the approaching 
close of their schedule, the Trainer 
encouraged her towards their greatest 
goal, the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
